message.content: During their meeting at the café "Central Perk" on Thursday morning, Yuriko shared her feedback on the demo website with Li Hua. Specifically, she expressed that she appreciated the color scheme, which reflected the gentle vibe of her studio. Yuriko suggested adding a section for community outreach programs, believing it would highlight the impact of her work and provide more detail about the programs she offers. She also proposed including testimonials from participants and photos from past events, which she thought would enhance the engagement and authenticity of the page. Li Hua responded enthusiastically to these suggestions, agreeing that they were excellent ideas and expressing his intention to help brainstorm some more detailed ideas for these sections. Li Hua also promised to assist with the layout and presentation to ensure the feedback section matched the overall aesthetic of the studio. The feedback and collaboration demonstrated a strong partnership between Yuriko and Li Hua, aimed at enhancing the demo website and ultimately contributing to the success of Yuriko's studio.
